notes:
REF-BM-03: Collected title and description are editable only after saving, not in the preview before saving.
REF-BM-04: Title, description, tags, and note are editable, but the URL is not.
REF-BM-12: Search covers title, description, and note but omits URL.
REF-BM-14: The #tag search syntax is not parsed or supported.
REF-BM-15: Boolean operators, grouping, and literal-operator quoting are unsupported.
REF-BM-16: Quoted phrases are treated as literal text including quote characters.
REF-BM-20: There is no multi-selection or bulk-action facility.
REF-BM-21: There is no whole-filtered-collection bulk action.
REF-BM-22: Bookmark-list sorting is not configurable.
REF-BM-23: Notes are stored and displayed as escaped plain text, without Markdown rendering.
REF-BM-24: A readable text extraction is stored in JSON and shown through a shared viewer, not preserved as single-file HTML; PDFs are unsupported.
REF-BM-25: Internet Archive snapshot creation is absent.
REF-BM-26: Bookmarks cannot be archived and hidden from default results.
REF-BM-27: No reversible bookmark archive lifecycle exists distinct from deletion.
REF-BM-28: There is no archived-bookmarks list.
REF-BM-29: Saved filter bundles are absent.
REF-BM-30: Netscape HTML import is absent.
REF-BM-31: Netscape HTML export is absent.
REF-BM-32: Display-related personal settings are absent.
